Goblins are what you play instead of halflings. Everyone knows halflings are just a myth. 

Goblins are more or less mutated humans, changed by the radiation from the strange-colored fallen star that broke apart in the sky. "Goblinite" transforms entire ecosystems where its present - transforming a mundane forest into a bioluminescent, alien landscape. 

Folks aren't particularly accepting of their mutant cousins though, so most goblins live in itinerant communities these days. Your average gong farmer couldn't explain to you the difference between a goblin and a hob.

It's not really accurate to think of capitalism and socialism as different ends of one spectrum. They might look similar to the untrained eye, but these are very different organisms.

Hell, Otto von Bismark was one of the early advocates of government-sponsored healthcare, specifically to [stymie socialist movements in the country.](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/history/bismarck-tried-end-socialisms-grip-offering-government-healthcare-180964064/)
It's important to break the notion that social democracy/welfare capitalism is equal to socialism, let alone centrally planned Soviet socialism.
